chunking_policy.target_range_words: roughly 40-80 depending on coherent paragraph/quote/caption boundaries
chunking_policy.overlap: 10-20% where a whole-sentence overlap fits the range

columns.source_id: Stable source identifier shared by rows.
columns.core_concept: Document nature / core concept supplied before upload.
columns.chunk_id: Stable sequential chunk identifier within section.
columns.include: true/false; false excludes row from retrieval while preserving audit history.
columns.record_id: Optional stable source-record identifier for Context Mesh compatibility.
columns.heading: Heading hierarchy metadata; inherited by child chunks.
columns.subheading: Subheading hierarchy metadata; inherited by child chunks.
columns.text_chunk: Retrieval text only; links/citations/reference data are kept in metadata fields.
columns.citations: Pipe-separated citation markers/text extracted from chunk.
columns.reference_materials: Pipe-separated reference IDs linking to the separate reference table.
columns.links: Pipe-separated URLs; not mixed into text_chunk.
columns.images: Pipe-separated image captions/labels; image captions may also have their own chunk_type=image_caption row.
columns.related_record_ids: Pipe-separated strong human-curated Context Mesh record links.
columns.reviewer_notes: Administrative HITL notes; never source evidence.

backward_compatibility: MiAi still accepts v1 rows containing record_id, heading and text and rechunks them with v2 rules.
